raw_response: {"diagnosis": "About 30% of customers (the 01–04 codes, from the 2026-01-15 CRM migration) carry numeric region codes instead of names, and silver_customers passes them through unmapped. raw_region_map provides a unique one-to-one lookup from every code to a region name, so silver_customers can translate codes through it while keeping existing names unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
